message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Children under 5 must be in a rear‑facing seat. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02%).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• Yield to pedestrians in crosswalks.
• At four‑way stops, the first vehicle to arrive has the right of way. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during any weather that reduces visibility.
• Fog lights may only be used when visibility is less than 200 ft. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must display a valid registration sticker.
• Towing a vehicle requires a valid license and insurance. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in fire lanes, handicap spaces (unless you have a permit), or on sidewalks.
• Parking in a “no parking” zone is a ticket. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • All vehicles must stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Failure to stop can result in a fine and points on your license. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals at least 100 ft before changing lanes.
• Do not exceed the speed limit when overtaking. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Vehicle Safety Equipment** | • All vehicles must have functioning brakes, tires, lights, and horn.
• Airbags must be present and functional. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | Texas Department of Insurance – Motor Vehicle Insurance | | **Points System & License Suspension** | • Accumulating 4 or more points in 2 years can lead to license suspension.
• Points are added for violations such as speeding, DUI, reckless driving, etc. | Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) – Driver’s License Information | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Official website: [dps.texas.gov](https://www.dps.texas.gov) *Contains the most recent statutes, penalties, and driver education resources.* 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online through the Texas Legislature’s website: [statutes.texas.gov](https://statutes.texas.gov) *Provides the legal text for all traffic laws.* 3. **TxDOT** – For road‑specific regulations, speed limits, and construction updates: [txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) 4. **Local County Courts** – For specific case law or recent changes in local ordinances. --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always keep your license, registration, and proof of insurance in the vehicle.** - **Use hands‑free devices if you need to talk on the phone.** - **Check for school bus stop signs before proceeding.** - **Adjust your speed for weather and road conditions; Texas can have sudden storms.** - **If you’re new to Texas, consider a refresher course on state traffic laws.** Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law, penalty, or how to handle a particular situation!
